cases.name: Nona Carol Dirksmeyer
cases.about: She attended Arkansas Tech University and was a sophomore music education major, participating as a member of both the Concert Chorale and the Chamber Choir. She was a member of the First Christian Church Disciples of Christ and in the Church Choir. Also member of the Big Brothers & Big Sisters; former Pope County Fair Queen and Miss Teen Mt. Nebo; She was crowned Miss Petit Jean Valley 2005 and went on to compete in the Miss Arkansas Pageant in 2005.
cases.narrative: On 12/15/2005, she was found deceased inside her apartment. She had been brutally stabbed and beaten to death with the base of her own floor lamp.
